title: Audio evidence
responsibility: Presents a recording with playback, transcript, provenance and download controls.

inputs.name: AudioEvidence.item
inputs.description: The recorded audio item: id, title, category, file and status are required, the card also reads the optional source, capturedAt, phase, standing, note, transcript, mimeType, durationSeconds and missing fields, and the whole item is passed to EvidenceProvenance. A missing flag, an empty file or a playback error shows the unavailable message with the not-proven badge, and a positive finite durationSeconds takes precedence over the duration the audio element loads.

inputs.name: AudioEvidence.assetBase
inputs.description: Required URL prefix that the component joins to item.file with no separator added, forming both the audio src and the download href, so it must end with a slash because item.file is normally a bare file name. An empty string makes item.file the URL as written, which the browser resolves against the current document.

inputs.name: AudioEvidence.idPrefix
inputs.description: Optional prefix for the card's HTML id, which is idPrefix followed by item.id, and it defaults to 'evidence-'. Give each extra copy on the same page its own prefix, because the title link always targets '#evidence-' plus item.id and ignores this value.

outputs.name: AudioEvidence
outputs.description: Audio card with native controls and preload set to none, so nothing is fetched until playback starts, a transcript disclosure that opens when text exists, and provenance with the capture time when recorded; starting one clip pauses other audio in the document, and destroying the card pauses its own player. When the clip is unavailable (missing flag, empty file or playback error), the player is replaced by an unavailable message and the card shows the not-proven badge and the note, while the download link, named from the sanitized title, phase and recognized extension, appears only when item.file is set and item.missing is false; loaded metadata fills a missing duration without changing the recorded status.
